title: Blood Pressure Measurement in Mice Using Tail Cuff Method
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yetften
materials: Allow mouse to sit on the warming pad until a body temp of 32-35ºC is achieved. Use the infrared thermometer at the base of the tail to read the subject’s body temperature.
A window labeled “Basic Session Info” will appear.
Type in your name under the technician section.
Change gloves between groups of mice.

Mouse configuration: 1. Place mouse into an appropriate sized restrainer. 2. Place the tail through the groove of the back of the restrainer and tighten screw. 3. Feed the tail through the occlusion cuff first and then through the VPR cuff second. Ensure a snug fit but do not force the tail through either cuff as this will cause constriction and yield false pressure readings. 4. Allow mouse to sit on the warming pad until a body temp of 32-35ºC is achieved. Use the infrared thermometer at the base of the tail to read the subject’s body temperature. 5. Make sure the body temperature does not exceed 39ºC.

steps.title: Initialize CODA Software
steps.instruction: Launch the CODA software and configure the device connection.

substeps.instruction: Click on the CODA icon on the supplied laptop.
Highlight the line reading 'CODA 8 – Channels 1-8 (8)' in red letters and click 'Use these devices'.

steps.title: Create New Experiment
steps.instruction: Set up a new experiment file and enter basic session information.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to File > New > Experiment.
Enter the experiment name and click next.
In the 'Basic Session Info' window, enter the session name and set the following parameters: Number of Sets: 1, Time Between Sets: 00:00:30, Cycles per Set: 20, and Time Between Cycles: 00:00:05.
Click next.

steps.title: Manage Specimens and Technician Info
steps.instruction: Input animal IDs and technician details, then assign animals to channels.

substeps.instruction: In the 'Specimen Selection' window, click 'Manage Specimens' and enter animal IDs (use the + button to add more mice).
Enter your name in the technician section.
Save the information and close the window.
Under 'Specimen Pool', highlight each animal and click the right arrow to assign them to a channel.

steps.title: Configure Session Parameters
steps.instruction: Define the pressure and display settings for the session.

substeps.instruction: Click next to open the 'Session Parameters' window.
Set Max Occlusion Pressure to 250, Deflation Time to 20, and Min Volume to 15.
Under 'Display Style', choose one channel per graph.
Click next.

steps.title: Finalize Script and Prepare Mice
steps.instruction: Verify the session script and ensure mice are physiologically prepared.

substeps.instruction: In the 'Session Script' window, ensure the occlusion wait time is set to 5000.
Verify that all cuffs are properly secured.
Confirm that mice have reached a temperature of 32-35ºC.
Click next, then finish to start the experiment.
Change gloves between groups of mice.

steps.title: Clean Equipment and Workspace
steps.instruction: Sanitize the restraints and bench top after the experiment is complete.

substeps.instruction: Remove mice and wipe off each restraint with 10% Nolvasan before adding new mice.
After all experiments, clean equipment using 10% Nolvasan (do not use alcohol).
Wipe the surrounding bench top with Coverage Plus working solution (diluted to 1/256 in water).
